outcome: Proportion of naive regulatory T-cells (nTreg) at birth, 6 months, and 12 months
finding: Infants who developed food allergy had a lower proportion of naive regulatory T-cells at birth.
mod_finding: Exposure to labor, compared to pre-labor Cesarean section, was associated with a transient decrease in nTreg, and this decrease was more evident among infants who later developed food allergy.
